Only works in PvE game modes.

Ammo Brick pickups generally grant 1 additional ammo to #element.

#exceptions

#nonBenefit

Functions the same way regardless of what spawned the Ammo Brick.

Context: normal Ammo Bricks grant 25-33% of your Total Reserves by default.

var element = <arc/>Arc Weapons matching the Ammo Type

var exceptions = Machine Guns receive 7 additional ammo, Trace Rifles receive 10% of their Total Reserves (rounded up) as additional ammo. 

var nonBenefit = empty
// <yellow Wardcliff Coil /> does not receive any extra ammo on pickups.
